explanation.body: On its live record it counts 3 live, 37 measuring, 20 proving, 6 study. No study record is on file for this page; what it shows is its current reading, updated on its normal schedule.
explanation.summary: For every tool classified on this page, how strongly its numbers are backed, read from that tool's own published record. Coverage is partial: the counts on this page name how many tools are classified, and the rest join as their classifications are assembled.

joining_note: Every tool designed for this site is on this page: all 70, each with its proving state read from its own record.

missing.what_and_when: No study record is on file for this page; what it shows is its current reading, updated on its normal schedule.

source: Each tool's own published record, read exactly as it was published, with the public scoreboard's published grading where a tool's grades live there

states.definition: The tool's numbers are the counted result of a study that has already run on the record.
The tool publishes calls or cards to the permanent record and those are being graded against what prices did next, with some grades in and some still waiting.
The tool is published and working, but its own claim has not been graded or proven yet; grading or a verdict is still to come.
The page is built, but the records it reads have not arrived or built up yet, so it shows nothing, or only its definition, until they do.
The tool only reports, filters, calculates or counts from records on file; it makes no forecast claim of its own, so there is nothing to grade.
states.words: A measuring tool, nothing to prove
